turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Our hamster escaped last night. The cage door was open. Help.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Don't worry, they're usually still in the house. Close doors to keep him in one area and check behind sofas and under the fridge.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Can I ask about something else? My son turns seventeen next month and he's desperate to start driving.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Exciting times. Will he book proper lessons with an instructor, or are you planning to teach him yourself in the family car?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Okay, quick break, I need to talk to my roommate. I'll tell you when I'm done.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Have you seen my calculator? The graphing one.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Is it the grey one with the cracked screen?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yes! Exam's at two and I can't find it anywhere.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I borrowed it on Tuesday, sorry. It's in my bag by the door.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: You could have told me. I nearly bought a new one.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I know, I know. I'll buy you a coffee after your exam, deal?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sorry, that was rude of me, go on.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: It's okay, I was only saying the cake's ready.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Sure thing. So, an instructor for him, or the family car with you in charge?
